definitions.explanation: The first day of the work week in Japan. The kanji 月 means 'moon' and relates to the Latin 'Luna' for Monday.

examples.japanese: {月曜日|げつようび}に{会|あ}いましょう。
{今日|きょう}は{月曜日|げつようび}です。
{月曜日|げつようび}から{金曜日|きんようび}まで{働|はたら}きます。
examples.english: I work from Monday to Friday.

notes: All days of the week in Japanese end with 曜日 (youbi, 'day of the week'). Monday uses 月 (moon), similar to how 'Monday' derives from 'Moon day' in English. Can be abbreviated to 月曜 (getsuyou) in casual speech or writing.
